characters.name: Mestertyven (yngstesønnen)
characters.description: En ressurssterk, blakk unggutt som lærer seg kriminell finesse for å overleve, men som også har en egen moral og vil ut av livet som tyv.
characters.look: A wiry, nimble young man of about twenty-two with a sharp-featured, clever face, a pointed chin, quick dark-brown eyes under arched eyebrows, a sly lopsided grin and a thin black moustache. Short curly black hair pokes out from under a small dark-grey wool flat cap worn tilted over one eye. He wears a long, worn bottle-green parka with deep pockets over a cream hoodie, a thin red scarf, charcoal jeans and black leather boots.

characters.name: Mestertyven i dress
characters.description: Mestertyven i en dress han fant blant tingene til ranerne, sydd til en mann som er vant til at folk reiser seg når han kommer inn i et rom. Slik kjører han hjem til faren som en annen storkar.
characters.look: The master thief dressed like a very rich man: the same wiry young man of about twenty-two with a sharp-featured, clever face, a pointed chin, a sly lopsided grin, a thin black moustache and short curly black hair, now slicked back. He wears a made-to-measure midnight-blue three-piece suit with a white pocket square, a pale-pink shirt, a bottle-green silk tie, a heavy gold watch, oxblood loafers and a long camel overcoat.

characters.name: Mestertyven i filler
characters.description: Mestertyven i utslitte klær og en hullete jakke, så elendig og lurvete at det er helt ynkelig. Ingen ser på en som ser sånn ut. I sekken har han tre levende harer.
characters.look: The master thief disguised as a pitiful down-and-out: the same wiry young man with a sharp-featured, clever face, a pointed chin, a sly lopsided grin and a thin black moustache, his cheeks smudged with dirt and his curly black hair uncombed. He wears a filthy brown work jacket full of holes over a stained grey hoodie, baggy ripped tracksuit bottoms and split, muddy trainers, and carries a big lumpy sack over one shoulder.

characters.name: Mestertyven som engel
characters.description: Mestertyven med et stort, hvitt laken over seg og de to gåsevingene faren feide aske med på ryggen. Oppe i lønnetreet forkynner han presten at han skal tas opp levende til Guds rike.
characters.look: The master thief disguised as an angel: the same wiry young man with a sharp-featured, clever face, a pointed chin, a sly lopsided grin and a thin black moustache. A big white bedsheet is draped over his head and body like a long hooded robe, leaving his face free, and two old grey-and-white goose wings, the kind used for sweeping ash from a stove, are tied onto his back with string, a little crooked. His bare feet peek out below the sheet.

characters.name: Mestertyven som kjerring
characters.description: Mestertyven i et fillete skjørt og en strikkejakke lånt av ei gammel kone, med stokk i handa og pose over skulderen. Hun fryser så fælt, og hun har to lommelerker med seg.
characters.look: The master thief disguised as a crooked old beggar woman: a stooped, limping figure leaning on a wooden walking cane, with a cloth bag over one shoulder. A faded floral headscarf is tied over a tangled grey wig, but a thin black moustache and a sly grin peek out underneath. He wears a baggy, bobbly grey knitted cardigan, a ragged brown skirt that is too short, laddered thick tights and muddy rubber boots.

characters.name: Mestertyven med geiteskjegg
characters.description: Mestertyven i filler, med sot i ansiktet, parykk og et stort skjegg av geitehår, så ingen kan kjenne ham igjen. Han skal i bryllup med ei tønne hjemmebrygg og må holde fingeren i hullet i tønna.
characters.look: The master thief disguised as a wretched old carter, unrecognisable: his face smeared with soot, a shaggy grey wig and a huge, bushy false beard of grey-white goat hair reaching down to his belt, with only his sly, narrow dark eyes showing. He wears a squashed black knitted hat, a ragged, oil-stained brown coat tied with orange baler twine, patched trousers and cracked rubber boots.

characters.name: Den gamle dama i basen
characters.description: En sliten eldre kvinne som holder til i en ombygd industrilåve og lever tett på en gjeng hun frykter, men som likevel gir gutten en sjanse til å overleve natta.
characters.look: A short, round old woman of about seventy with red apple cheeks, a button nose, shrewd twinkling blue eyes, deep laugh lines and wisps of white hair escaping from a red-and-white checked headscarf knotted at the back of her neck. She wears a worn, faded sunflower-yellow hoodie over a long flowered nightgown, thick wool socks and tartan felt slippers, with a big wooden ladle sticking out of the hoodie's front pocket.

characters.name: Faren
characters.description: En blakk far som leier den gamle husmannsplassen nedenfor storgården og har knapt til husleia. Han blir drevet opp alleen for å be stormannen om dattera på vegne av sønnen.
characters.look: A thin, timid man of about sixty-five with a long, droopy, worried face, big sad grey eyes under bushy brows, a red-tipped nose, sunken cheeks with grey stubble and thin grey hair sticking up in tufts. He wears a threadbare mouse-brown cardigan with leather elbow patches over a washed-out grey T-shirt, baggy corduroy trousers and old rubber clogs, and wraps a worn grey-and-blue striped wool blanket round his shoulders like a shawl.

characters.name: Bonden med oksene
characters.description: En bonde med en gammel pickup og dyrehenger som skal kjøre oksene til slakteriet uten at kona får vite det, og som blir lurt tre ganger på den samme grusveien.
characters.look: A big, broad, soft-hearted farmer of about forty with a round, weathered face, a bulbous red nose, small worried blue eyes, large ears and a short, curly light-brown beard. He wears a battered brown waxed cap, a dark-green rain jacket over a woolly sheepskin-lined vest and a blue work shirt, brown work trousers and muddy green rubber boots.

characters.name: Stormannen
characters.description: En lokal rikmann med makt og prestisje som setter stadig mer ydmykende prøver for å avsløre mestertyven, men ender med å bli lurt på egne premisser.
characters.look: A stout, self-important man of about fifty-five with a huge round belly, a pink double chin, rosy jowls, small twinkling eyes, a snub nose, a neat grey moustache waxed into two curly tips and grey hair curling over his ears. He wears a tobacco-brown tweed jacket over a canary-yellow knitted waistcoat stretched tight across his belly, a pale-blue shirt, a gold watch, grey trousers and shiny brown brogues.

characters.name: Stormannens datter
characters.description: Smart og snill, med sterk integritet; hun lar seg ikke blende av triks, men krever at mestertyven kan lære å gi tilbake.
characters.look: A clever young woman of about twenty-two with a heart-shaped face, a dimple in one cheek, lively grey-green eyes that always seem to be laughing, a small straight nose and nut-brown hair in two braids pinned into round buns over her ears. She wears an apricot-coloured wool jumper with a white shirt collar showing, dark jeans and white trainers, with a small enamel lily-of-the-valley pin on the jumper.

characters.name: Presten
characters.description: Selvsikker og moraliserende, overbevist om at han ikke kan lures—helt til mestertyven bruker forkledning og religiøst språk mot ham.
characters.look: A tall, stiff, very proud vicar of about fifty with a long thin face, a long pointed nose held high, raised eyebrows, a small pursed mouth and a long, pointed sandy-grey beard. He wears a black clerical shirt with a white collar tab under a long black wool coat, dark trousers and polished black shoes, and clasps a small black hymn book to his chest.

places.name: the Robbers' Barn
places.look: The inside of an old industrial barn deep in the forest, turned into a home: a high, dark ceiling with steel beams, corrugated metal walls, a big black wood stove, a battered brown leather sofa, a kitchen corner with a steel sink, and pallets of stolen goods along the walls: boxed flat-screen TVs, bicycles and three garden grills. At one end, big sliding doors open onto a gravel yard.

places.name: the Gravel Road
places.look: A narrow gravel road winding through dark spruce forest and birches round a wooded ridge, with deep puddles, a grassy middle strip, heather and juniper bushes along the ditches, and a few tall birches leaning out over the road. No houses, no signs and no lamp posts.

places.name: the Big Farm
